version1.privacy: Inference and video processing on device; research sample is not uploaded to third-party inference services.
version1.poseAnalysisMode: 2D skeleton overlay and image-plane elbow/knee/trunk-angle estimates; no trajectory view

poseEngine.simulator: Use bundled MediaPipe Full directly: missing Vision weights and intermittent setup stall are known runtime limitations.

research.sample: IMG_9673.mov (provided locally; not included in the repository)
research.trackingStatus: Archived research only. Bat trajectory was removed from version 1.0 on 2026-10-20; tracking engines are not active application dependencies.
research.qualification: Desktop feasibility comparison; results do not establish iPhone/iPad latency, battery use or overall accuracy.

provisionalSelection.pose: Apple Vision by native integration cost; no accuracy superiority established
limitations: Original desktop experiment used one batting clip and did not qualify iOS accuracy.
iOS 26.1 simulator Vision lacks human-pose weights; native Full fallback now runs.
Independent 60-frame human-labelled acceptance set fails the original 90% PCK@0.05 gate for Full and Heavy.
Simulator acceptance does not establish physical camera, energy or thermal behaviour; physical-device validation is explicitly out of scope.

decisionHistory.change: User removed bat trajectory from the current version. Retain video tools, manual annotations, dual-video comparison and human pose analysis. Archive existing bat-tracking experiments.
User requires simulator-only development and acceptance for iPhone/iPad; no physical-device verification gate.
Correct product name to Coach Insights throughout app, native project, identifiers, tests, docs and research presentation; use burgundy #722F37 theme.

Reproducible Vision runtime gap justifies native MediaPipe Full fallback. Full and optional Heavy compared against a separate 60-frame human-labelled baseball acceptance set; neither passes the original quality gate. No automatic reduction of the quality commitment.

developmentPlan.scheduling: No staffing or calendar schedule; implementation follows dependencies and acceptance gates
developmentPlan.executionStatus: Video workflow, editable annotations, synchronized comparison, offline pose pipeline and export implemented. Final iPhone/iPad simulator regression: 79 passed, zero failures, one device-specific skip; two additional size checks passed. Release compiled for arm64 simulator and iOS. Pose quality V1-048 and final delivery confirmation V1-062 remain open.
developmentPlan.validation: iPhone and iPad simulators only; physical-device verification is not required per user instruction
